newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser, Phelps Dodge unit in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser, Phelps Dodge unit in joint venture.

text.p: Kaiser Aluminum Corp and Phelps Dodge Corp unit Accuride Corp said they signed a letter of intent to form a global joint venture company to produce aluminum wheels for the commercial transportation industry.
Under the deal, the joint venture will buy certain wheel manufacturing assets at Kaiser's Erie, Pennsylvania, facility.
It will increase production capacity by more than 40 percent, bringing output to about 500,000 heavy aluminum wheels annually.

Accuride and Kaiser each will own 50 percent of the new company, which will design, manufacture, and market wheels for truck and trailer original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and the motor-carrier parts aftermarket.
